proof_explanation: The negate function now correctly implements total Boolean negation by returning Bool.not(value). This directly satisfies the law negate_matches_boolean_not, which requires negate(value) to equal Bool.not(value) for all Bool values. The proof via {==} reflexivity tactic verifies this equivalence, as the function implementation now directly produces the required negation.

seeded_attack.reason: The seeded attack violates the negate_matches_boolean_not law because it fails to implement total Boolean negation. Any implementation that does not compute Bool.not(value) for all Bool inputs will produce results that contradict the required equality negate(value) == Bool.not(value), thus failing the law's proof obligations.
